definitions.gloss: to roll up, to wrap up in
definitions.explanation: To wind or wrap something into something else.
To get someone involved in a situation, often against their will.

examples.japanese: ⟦{髪|かみ}→髪：02196_kami⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ドライヤー→ドライヤー：05076_doraiyaa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{巻|ま}き{込|こ}まれた→巻き込まれる：21634_makikomareru⟧。
examples.english: My hair got caught in the hair dryer.

examples.japanese: ⟦{機械|きかい}→機械：02366_kikai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧スカーフ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{巻|ま}き{込|こ}まれない→巻き込まれる：21634_makikomareru⟧よう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{気|き}をつけて→気をつける：09771_kiwotsukeru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please be careful not to let your scarf get caught in the machine.

examples.japanese: ⟦{事件|じけん}→事件：01568_jiken⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{巻|ま}き{込|こ}まれた→巻き込まれる：21634_makikomareru⟧。
examples.english: I got caught up in an incident.

examples.japanese: ⟦{周|まわ}り→周り：01732_mawari⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{巻|ま}き{込|こ}まないで⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。

⟦{友人|ゆうじん}→友人：03649_yuujin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{借金|しゃっきん}→借金：03203_shakkin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{巻|ま}き{込|こ}まれて→巻き込まれる：21634_makikomareru⟧、⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧⟦{困|こま}っている→困る：00861_komaru⟧。
examples.english: I've gotten dragged into my friend's debt problems and I'm really struggling.

notes:
{巻|ま}き{込|こ}む is a compound verb meaning to roll/wrap something in, or to involve someone in a situation.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: ⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧ (transitive)
- Formed from ⟦{巻|ま}く→巻く：02418_maku⟧ (to wind) + ⟦{込|こ}む→込む：00719_komu⟧ (into)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- 〜⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{巻|ま}き{込|こ}む: to involve someone in ~
- 〜⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{巻|ま}き{込|こ}まれる: to get caught up in ~ (passive)
- ⟦{周|まわ}り→周り：01732_mawari⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{巻|ま}き{込|こ}む: to involve those around you
- ⟦{事件|じけん}→事件：01568_jiken⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{巻|ま}き{込|こ}まれる: to get caught up in an incident

USAGE:
The passive form {巻|ま}き{込|こ}まれる is very common and often implies being involuntarily dragged into a situation, whether a conflict, accident, or trouble.
